args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions and has been failing health checks (error rate 0.18, unhealthy). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all regions now report v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so if it needs to be redeployed later, that would require change-manager approval per policy.
